description: Rezones part of Aspen Ridge for residential development.
Removes 16.92 hectares from Aspen Ridge Concept Plan.
Adds two multi-unit and one residential care home site.
Increases Aspen Ridge park space by 0.25 hectares.

chips.text: DCAL Developments plans to service 46 lots this year in the amended area.
Two individuals raised concerns about traffic, parking, and impact on low-density homes.
A linear park in the neighborhood is slated to begin construction this year.

description: Rezones 702 and 706 Victoria Avenue for high-density.
Permits a six-story, 33-37 unit condominium building.
Zoning agreement controls height and specific design features.

chips.text: Administration clarified short-term rentals require inclusion in zoning agreement.
Residents seeking bespoke, lock-and-leave condominium housing.
Public raised concerns about traffic, lane use, and construction impacts.
Project includes a green roof and protects mature boulevard trees.

description: Allows four units on 50-foot sites with two garden/garage suites.
Removes height limits for garden/garage suites with rear lane access.
Permits six units on corner lots in Transit Development Area.

chips.text: Administration wants City Council review for six-unit corner lot developments.
Secondary suites and garden suites progressed from discretionary to permitted use.
Public comments raised concerns about traffic, parking, and servicing.
Zoning bylaw regulations will be simplified for clarity.

description: City's Planning Commission has $7,000 for 2026 conferences.

chips.text: New Planning Commission members are encouraged to attend.
